# SheetJS Community Edition

Pinned version: 0.20.3. Vendored locally so business files are parsed in the browser without contacting a CDN. No workbook formulas are executed by this application's import adapter.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

License: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE (saved as SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt).

Official integration documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
